findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cancel_studio_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cancel_studio_booking, reschedule_studio_booking, check_caricature_booth_credits · Private data: list_services, request_studio_booking · Public sink: request_studio_booking, cancel_studio_booking, reschedule_studio_booking, request_quote, buy_gift_voucher, start_caricature_booth_demo, buy_caricature_booth_credits, check_caricature_booth_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cancel_studio_booking, reschedule_studio_booking, check_caricature_booth_credits · Private data: list_services, request_studio_booking · Public sink: request_studio_booking, cancel_studio_booking, reschedule_studio_booking, request_quote, buy_gift_voucher, start_caricature_booth_demo, buy_caricature_booth_credits, check_caricature_booth_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
